name: codeguru-reviewer
description: This section provides documentation for the Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer API operations.

subcommands.name: associate-repository
subcommands.description: Use to associate an Amazon Web Services CodeCommit repository or a repository managed by Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections with Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer.

subcommands.name: create-code-review
subcommands.description: Use to create a code review with a CodeReviewType of RepositoryAnalysis.

subcommands.name: describe-code-review
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata associated with the code review along with its status.

subcommands.name: describe-recommendation-feedback
subcommands.description: Describes the customer feedback for a CodeGuru Reviewer recommendation.

subcommands.name: describe-repository-association
subcommands.description: Returns a RepositoryAssociation object that contains information about the requested repository association.

subcommands.name: disassociate-repository
subcommands.description: Removes the association between Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer and a repository.

subcommands.name: list-code-reviews
subcommands.description: Lists all the code reviews that the customer has created in the past 90 days.

subcommands.name: list-recommendation-feedback
subcommands.description: Returns a list of RecommendationFeedbackSummary objects that contain customer recommendation feedback for all CodeGuru Reviewer users.

subcommands.name: list-recommendations
subcommands.description: Returns the list of all recommendations for a completed code review.

subcommands.name: list-repository-associations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of RepositoryAssociationSummary objects that contain summary information about a repository association.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns the list of tags associated with an associated repository resource.

subcommands.name: put-recommendation-feedback
subcommands.description: Stores customer feedback for a CodeGuru Reviewer recommendation.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an associated repository.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from an associated repository.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: code-review-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until a code review is complete.

subcommands.name: repository-association-succeeded
subcommands.description: Wait until a repository association is complete.
